scope: Actual deployed PWA assets, isolated guest Chromium iPhone viewport and read-only NFL regressions.

checks.name: The real HTTPS frontend serves the app with security headers and no developer-dashboard redirect
The deployed manifest has standalone launch, same-origin scope and 192/512 PNG definitions
/icon-192.png is an actual correctly sized PNG on the deployed origin
/icon-512.png is an actual correctly sized PNG on the deployed origin
/apple-touch-icon.png is an actual correctly sized PNG on the deployed origin
The actual v8 service worker matches the reviewed source and excludes APIs, mutations, foreign origins and authenticated HTML
Production health verifies the preserved Supabase database and private Python service without starting work
Existing real NFL games still load for a guest and retain the NFL identity namespace
Original DraftKings Predictions API retains a truthful missing-feed diagnostic without queueing an alternative
/api/ledger denies the guest and instructs browsers not to cache its response
/api/bets denies the guest and instructs browsers not to cache its response
The actual iPhone-sized settings page exposes Apple install metadata, safe-area viewport and correct Safari instructions
The real browser installs the worker and caches only public assets, including the offline shell
A real denied Wallet request never enters service-worker CacheStorage
Actual offline navigation opens the public cached shell rather than any authenticated account page

limitations: Physical iPhone Safari Add to Home Screen and standalone launch were not performed.
No sign-in, private user record read/write, new account, new model run or market refresh POST was performed.
Optional user-approved encrypted device history was not created or decrypted.
Missing authorized DraftKings feed and general language-model credentials remain actual integration limitations.
